messages:
marco: Heads-up: restore for corp-zen hit `Decrypt AccessDenied` at 05:17. Backup job shows auth succeeded but theres no KMS Decrypt entry in audit for the CMK. Anyone seen an audit hole like this?
kms-bot: Alert created: INCIDENT-2026-141. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-audit-missing
alyssa: We did a key-escrow config change last night to centralize escrow entries into `keystore-main`. Could the escrow mapping be pointing to old SA aliases?
piotr: Checking proxy logs now. If proxy denies before forwarding, KMS never logs Decrypt. Pulling lines: `2026-11-09T05:17:02Z WARN req=aa11 principal=svc-data/uploader mapping_lookup=MISS -> 403 no-escrow-grant`.
tanya: That looks like an alias mismatch in our escrow-to-key index. We recently switched from email-based keys to short alias keys and some entries weren't migrated.
marco: Does the restore log show `ERROR: unable to decrypt CEK` or do we see a 403 from proxy?
piotr: Restore log snippet: ```ERROR: fetch CEK failed: AccessDenied
proxy response: 403 {"error":"no-escrow-grant"}``` No KMS Decrypt audit event.
alyssa: Immediate mitigation: I'm going to add a temporary escrow grant for `svc-data/uploader` on the affected CMK for 20 minutes so the restore can finish. Also will run a smoke decrypt through proxy to confirm.
kms-bot: Temporary grant applied (20m) by alyssa.
piotr: After the grant, smoke test: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <tok>" https://kms-proxy.internal/v1/decrypt -d '{"key":"ck-escrow-01","ciphertext":"..."}'` returned 200. KMS audit shows `protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"` at 05:18:07Z. Restore resumed; 7/8 shards restored; final shard retried and completed.
tanya: Post-incident actions: 1) Migrate escrow index to accept both full SA email and alias UID fallback; 2) Add a pre-rotation smoke test that renames an SA and asserts Decrypt events appear in KMS audit; 3) Emit a `kms.proxy.denied` metric and forward denied principal+key to SIEM as `kms_escrow_blocked`.
marco: Also add alert logic: if a backup/service principal has auth activity but zero KMS Decrypts for 10m, page oncall.
alyssa: For the temporary-file vuln found earlier in uploader v1 (writes `/tmp/backup-clear-*`), short-term set TMPDIR to `/var/opt/backups/tmp` with 0700 and unlink on success; long-term: move to streaming encrypt that never writes full plaintext to disk. I've filed GH-issue #11456 and linked it to this incident.
piotr: I'll update the escrow migration script and open PR for alias fallback. Tanya, can you own the proxy metric + SIEM forwarder?
tanya: Yep, taking ownership. ETA 72 hours for durable fixes + tests.
kms-bot: Post-incident checklist created and owners assigned: @alyssa (hotfix + docs), @piotr (migration PR), @tanya (proxy metrics+SIEM).
marco: Thanks team. We'll run a short blameless postmortem tomorrow. :thumbsup:
